greeting.text: Welcome. Is it a gift, or for your place?

lines.text: The freesias are lovely today. They smell nice.
I'll wrap even a single stem. No pressure.
Take your time. People talking to you is uncomfortable, right? Same for me.

flushRemark.text: It's okay, take all the time you need.

closers.endured: I shouldn't have chatted. Take your time.
closers.sos: Go ahead and take your call.
